notes.content:

 * Gave the whalebones in Point Hope a regular attack but reduced the frequency of spin attacks

Also fixed several text issues/typos!

notes.title: Geo Mythica Updates and More
notes.content:
It’s hard to believe we already started a new year. After recovering from the holiday festivities, progress with Geo Mythica has been ramping up and I’m excited to share some details.  


[h2]Beta Playtest going strong[/h2]

Everyone who signed up for the beta playtest has been super helpful with their feedback.
From identifying small bugs to sharing comments, I was able to make a lot of progress  with the game.

[h2]So what’s been updated?[/h2]

Well, a lot. Here’s a quick breakdown!

[list]
[*] Some of the more notable updates include new difficulty settings such as “Hard for no Reason” and “Ridiculously Easy”.

[*] Others include quality of life features like reassigning spells or not having hotkeys automatically change when party members leave/join.

[*] And one in particular I’m fairly keen on is language learning quizzes, a fun new addition.
[i](Hey, it’s not Babbel, but it’s still fun!)[/i]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44575597/d175b938835d76fba2d18cb187e23f98fdcf5fb1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44575597/204fca0e0f1bce594660cf1ded3cc0a1d91ddd4c.png[/img]

Outside of your typical bugs, minor tweaks and typos, that pretty much sums things up!

[h2]But wait, there’s more[/h2]

As we continue to refine Geo Mythica during the beta playtest, we’ll be [b]attending MAGFest again[/b] this year, which we’re particularly excited about!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44575597/2a273a4a9c644d1bcaf6f70b90a9c259c91c943f.png[/img]

As you’d expect, the anticipation of meeting new friends, connecting with old ones and having fun as we get feedback on our newest build is exciting.

However, [b]this event the MAGFest Orchestra will be performing one of Geo Mythica’s songs[/b], the airship theme titled “Let the World Be Wrong”!

(If you’d like a preview, here’s [url=https://chrisguin.bandcamp.com/track/let-the-world-be-wrong-flying]a clip from the OST you can listen to[/url])

So if you’re able to attend, stop on by and say hi at booth 11 and check out the live performance!



That’s it for now and thanks again for all of the support! 

Until next time… keep on adventuring!

- Chris

notes.title: Demo Update Announcement
notes.content:
As we continue making steady progress with Geo Mythica, we felt it was time to release an updated demo. This includes new features, improvements and fresh content! 

So whether you played it a while ago or haven’t downloaded it yet, now’s the perfect time to dig in.

[h2]What’s New in the Demo?[/h2]

Bug fixes aside, we added content and quality of life features that not only improves the experience, but extends game play a little too. Here’s a snapshot of what we’ve done.

[b]Atlas Menu:[/b] With the Atlas menu, you can now keep track of collectible items you’ve found in each location, helping you identify anything you may have missed on your journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44575597/49532d71f869477965a6cd0d13ac868b66eb7234.png[/img]

[b]The Frog of Completion:[/b] Whenever you collect all items in a specific location, the Frog of Completion in Mexico rewards you with a permanent stat boost for the character you choose!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44575597/e334a5e460c839ae7898c7b57ef915049ad1d809.png[/img]

[b]Updated Narrative Content:[/b] The first dungeon has additional content which sets up the overarching narrative better while getting you familiar with new strategies to use on your adventure.

[u]PLEASE NOTE:[/u] In light of the latter, we want to call out that [b][u]you won’t be able to use any save states made before beating the first area (San Luis Obispo).[/u][/b]

[u][b]This should have minimal impact[/b][/u] as it takes approximately 15 to 25 minutes to complete the first area.

[h2]More News on the Horizon[/h2]

As we continue to refine Geo Mythica, we’re preparing for a limited open beta playtest.

So stay tuned for more details [b]soon[/b] on how you can help us shape the final experience of Geo Mythica.

Until then, have fun with the new demo!

[h2]What else?[/h2]

In addition to the demo update, Geo Mythica will also be attending a couple of events we highly encourage you to check out and share with your friends.

[b]Be a Hero[/b] event hosted on Steam presented by Comic-Con Stuttgart is happening now until December 6th.  Showcasing lots of games featuring heroes going on a variety of adventures, we were honored to be part of the line up in this exciting event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44575597/e3461c2f26c0fd8edd1bc64d5586cd2714eb75aa.png[/img]

[b]MAGFest[/b] has graciously allowed us to exhibit the game once more. The team is eager to get back to the showroom floor to meet old friends, make new ones and share more updates and progress with Geo Mythica.

If you plan on attending, stop by and say hi. There may be something in it for you if you do ;)

That’s it for now, until next time… keep on adventuring!
- Chris
